name: global_kinematic_guidance_v1
hypothesis: The holonomic grid route selects a single 2.4m subgoal without heading feasibility; searching the current observed map directly to the legal pointgoal with the existing measured primitives can choose a less reversing detour. Execute only the first eight 0.3m primitives, retain existing boundary/guard/controller.
novelty: Moves kinematic feasibility into global route selection; no side lock, reverse cost change, forced forward-only, short-backing selection or tracker lookahead change. Closed direction-root, side binding/soft bias, short-backing, tangent field remain closed.
online_inputs: current native IMU/encoder pose and accepted direction
algorithm: Evaluate original planner once to preserve grid decision state and exact fallback. Use full observed grid inflated with existing clearance, unchanged minimum-prefix Hybrid A* directly to final goal, max3000 nodes. If success with >=2 waypoints, install first <=8 primitives ending in a zero-command waypoint. If search fails return original plan unchanged. Full planned path retained for audit, never full scene truth online.

qualification.saved_queries: all 10 original fresh E1 installed reference boundaries, once per frozen candidate
qualification.baseline: saved waypoints/expanded nodes reproduce with strict current inputs
qualification.safety: all successful full paths satisfy same sampled inflated observed-map clearance; all original map bytes unchanged; failed new search gives exact old plan
qualification.effect: reference2 full search succeeds and selected prefix initial reverse length < original2.7m; prefix direction changes no greater than original; at least one changed reference; otherwise reject

actual_gate: If qualified run same-version baseline E1 and candidate E1 once each. Require 90s rule arrival<=0.2m, no contact/unavailable contact, existing source gate p90<=.15 and >.3 outlier<=.1 and >=1000 pixels, complete provenance/video/native/requests plus implemented planning effect. Report total travel/net approach/reverse and switching separately. No source-gate-only or extra-progress-only navigation retention.
disclosure: Unknown remains unknown under inherited controlled exploration. Current observed map misses unseen obstacles; nominal path is not a physical safety certificate. Ground/safe-start priors and ideal lowlevel IMU plus initial pose gauge remain disclosed. Saved E1 is development; no generalization claim. No tuning if rejected.
